text:
megan: Noticing a spike in quota attribution errors after the sampler bump. Dashboards show many traces with project=NULL.

devon: Can you share an example request ID?

megan: req=000f12a3
Headers captured: `Authorization: ApiKey org=org-77 proj=proj-apple token=sk_live_...`
Proxy forwarded: `X-Org-Id: org-77` `X-Project-Ref: proj-apple`
Authz service expects `proj_id` claim in the binder.

akira: Sounds like our header canonicalization rules diverged between router and authz. Router writes X-Project-Ref, authz binder only reads X-Project-Id or token claim.

sam: This started after we changed sampling order to prefer key-affinity to reduce synthetic noise. The sampler can drop header-derived origin early which prevents the binder from seeing X-Project-Ref at all.

megan: Repro steps I used in staging: 1) set `routing.sampler.priority=affinity,key,origin` 2) send ApiKey request with both token claims and headers present. 3) observe missing project in traces.

devon: Quick mitigation: revert sampler priority in staging to `origin,affinity` and add a short-lived compatibility mapping in authz that accepts `X-Project-Ref` -> `proj_id`.

ops-bot: deploy queued: authz-compat-mapping -> staging (requester=devon)

akira: Long-term fix: consolidate canonical header names in the router contract and add a unit test to ensure header->token claim mapping remains symmetric. Also update the console to display a hint when project attribution is absent: "No project claim seen. Check proxy header mapping and sampler priority."

sam: I'll push a sampler flag that makes token claims authoritative when present (service accounts and user tokens), and add metric `authz.attribution.fallback_reason` with tags `sampler_drop`, `header_mismatch`, `missing_claim`.

megan: Can we also add a grafana panel that breaks attribution failures by `token_type` so support can quickly filter SA vs user tokens?

tara: I can add the panel and a tiny tooltip linking to the playbook. Draft tooltip: "Missing project in trace. Likely header canonicalization or sampler priority. See playbook."

devon: Deployed compat mapping to staging. Early telemetry shows ~70% of reprod traces now attribute correctly. Will keep it for the global canary while we roll the sampler flag.

megan: Thanks. I'll file a postmortem note and include the exact queries we used to detect the regression.

sam: Flagged the metric PR and included a small heatmap for `attribution.fallback_reason`. Pinging when visible in grafana. :thumbsup:
